title: arisarum ovatum
intro: Arisarum ovatum, commonly known as the lesser celandine, is a perennial aquatic plant that belongs to the arum family (Arisarum vulgare). The health benefits of Arisarum ovatum include its potential to help with inflammation and skin issues due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory, making it useful in treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arisarum ovatum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
